killedBy: reaching the configuration menu keeps the selection across a close, because building one is the slow part
the Configuration body loads when its pane first opens (issue #1015) builds the body once: a second visit keeps the same controls
why: Issue #1015. Every open loads and rebuilds the body, whether or not one exists. The controls are thrown away on each visit, and the rebuilt first view is `devMenuView({}, base)`, so the URL a developer built before pressing Back is no longer shown although the selection is still held -- the 'keeps the selection across a close' case reads exactly that. Built once and kept is how it behaved when it was built at construction.
